González-Regalado

González-Regalado is a Spanish house dedicated to the selection and development of high-expression gastronomic products, with special attention to Protected Designations of Origin and preparations representative of Spanish culinary heritage.

The firm emerges from an international perspective, where the value of the product of origin is perceived with special clarity. This external view has made it possible to structure a proposal designed to project Spanish gastronomic excellence in highly demanding global environments, particularly in Travel Retail and specialized distribution.

Each edition responds to a rigorous curation process: origin selection, aesthetic coherence, format adaptation, regulatory compliance, and logistical adjustment for international markets. The result is a balanced proposal between authenticity, sophistication, and commercial viability.

González-Regalado does not operate as a manufacturer, but as a house of selection and strategic development, preserving the identity of the product while positioning it in a contemporary and international context.
A sober and current interpretation of Spanish gastronomic excellence from a European and global perspective.
Founder

The company is led by Eduardo González-Regalado Batlles, whose personal experience outside of Spain has allowed him to identify the differential value of Spanish gastronomic products in international markets.
González-Regalado was born with a clear vision: to structure a solid proposal, regulatorily adapted and strategically positioned for international distribution environments and Travel Retail.
Its management is oriented to preserve the authenticity of origin, guarantee international standards, and project the Spanish product within a contemporary premium framework.
